literal.prompt: Как называется тонкая упругая корка морского льда?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt now asks for a thin elastic crust of sea ice. WMO describes nilas as a thin elastic crust under 10 cm (L29-L30); NSIDC explains that needle-like frazil crystals precede the continuous thin sheet called nilas (L83-L86), while pancake ice is a separate disk form created in rough water (L88). WMO identifies fast ice by attachment to shore or ocean floor (L30). These distinct definitions make nilas the unique answer.
literalGroups.locator: NSIDC Science of Sea Ice L83-L88; WMO Sea Ice L29-L30.

literalGroups.literal: Это нилас: тонкая упругая корка морского льда. Она образуется после смерзания начальных кристаллов и легко прогибается на волнах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC says frazil forms as ocean water begins freezing, and in calm water it develops into a continuous thin sheet called nilas (L83-L86). WMO characterizes nilas as a thin elastic crust (L30), supporting the explanation that it follows initial crystal formation and is flexible.
literalGroups.locator: NSIDC Science of Sea Ice L83-L86; WMO Sea Ice L29-L30.

literalGroups.literal: Нилас — упругая тонкая корка морского льда толщиной менее 10 см; она образуется, когда смерзаются начальные кристаллы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO identifies nilas as a thin elastic crust under 10 cm (L30). NSIDC states that in calm water frazil crystals first form grease ice, which develops into a continuous thin sheet called nilas (L83-L86); this grounds the note’s thickness and formation detail.
literalGroups.locator: WMO Sea Ice L29-L30; NSIDC Science of Sea Ice L83-L86.

literalGroups.literal: Игловидные кристаллы образуются в начале замерзания; это фразиль, который всплывает, скапливается и срастается в сплошной лист.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC identifies the small needle-like crystals formed as ocean water begins freezing as frazil (L83-L84); the crystals float, accumulate and bond into sheets (L84). This supports the morphology, early stage and distinction from a continuous nilas crust.
literalGroups.locator: NSIDC Science of Sea Ice L83-L86.

literalGroups.literal: Блинчатый лёд образуется в бурной воде как круглые диски; столкновения на волнах приподнимают их края.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC says that in rough water frazil accumulates into slushy circular disks called pancakes; waves bump them together and create raised edges (L88). This grounds the definition of pancake ice and differentiates its disk form from nilas.
literalGroups.locator: NSIDC Science of Sea Ice L88.

literalGroups.literal: Припай — морской лёд, прикреплённый к берегу или дну и поэтому не дрейфующий свободно.
literalGroups.primaryGround: WMO defines fast ice as sea ice attached to the shore or ocean floor (L30), which explains why it does not drift freely relative to the attachment.
